title: Interactive Plus Conversation Test
purpose: A source-grounded test of short turns, direct follow-ups, interruptions, hesitation, audible laughter, and audible sighing using the approved pilot cast and the existing Creative+ voice settings.

variants.description: Creative+ voice settings with conversation written and tagged as an exchanged performance rather than adjacent narration.

segments.speaker: connector
segments.text: "I have merely been transplanted from one scene of student-life to another." That's a young man writing from Cambridge in 1859.

segments.speaker: curious_guide
segments.text: Transplanted. That's such a brave word for, "I already miss home."

segments.speaker: archive_nerd
segments.text: And we have that sentence because the letter became a book, the book became a scan, and the scan became crawler food.

delivery.tone: quickly, delighted by the chain of survival

segments.speaker: archive_nerd
segments.text: That's the technical term. Pen to pixel in one hundred and fifty-four years.

segments.speaker: connector
segments.text: And after all that survival, what survives emotionally is so simple: he knows home is about to become somewhere he visits.

segments.speaker: curious_guide
segments.text: the idea of going away for good and all, and always hereafter being at home only as a visitor.

delivery.tone: measured, leaving space around the last word

segments.speaker: archive_nerd
segments.text: That phrase gets worse the longer you sit with it.

segments.speaker: connector
segments.text: It does. And then, a century and a half later, a blogger chooses the name Saudade—a word for longing that never quite resolves.

segments.speaker: curious_guide
segments.text: Wait. They named the blog after the feeling?

segments.speaker: connector
segments.text: Exactly. They had left Cape Verde, and years later they still thought about it every day.

segments.speaker: archive_nerd
segments.text: So one writer calls leaving a transplant. Another names the whole archive after the ache.
